president_2024.metric: Harris minus Trump, share of total national popular vote
president_2024.source_locator: FEC 2024 Presidential Election Results (Jan 16, 2025), Total row: HARRIS 75,017,613; TRUMP 77,302,580; TOTAL VOTES 155,238,302

house_2024.metric: Democratic minus Republican, share of total national House popular vote
house_2024.source_locator: Clerk of the House, Statistics of the Congressional Election of Nov 5, 2024, Recapitulation of Votes Cast for United States Representatives, Total row
house_2024.notes: Raw national sum; includes uncontested seats (some with no Republican or no Democrat on the ballot), so it is not an adjusted two-party measure.
